cells.gaps: No ratification of a shared African text on a digital matter is recorded; the Malabo Convention is neither signed nor ratified. No national law or rule giving effect to a shared text is recorded.
cells.note: The CEMAC QR-code payment standard of April 2026 is launched for the six CEMAC states, the Central African Republic named among them, so the country is bound by a community text and a statement that it has not signed Malabo is not stage 1. Nothing says it has ratified a shared text, so not 3.
